patch_list: Every store item — coin packs, gem bundles, remove ads and the starter bundles — is granted the instant you tap Buy, and no Google Play payment sheet ever opens. Because nothing is fetched from Play, purchases work fully offline with no Pl…

Turns every "watch a video" offer into an instant payout. Coins, gems and boosters that the game offers in exchange for sitting through a rewarded advert are credited the moment you tap, with no video to play, no countdown and no waiting —…
Bypasses client-side receipt and signature verification in the game's native engine, allowing free store purchases to be validated and credited instantly.

Removes the full-screen advert that plays at the end of every race, so the results screen comes up straight away instead of behind an ad you have to sit through or skip. The race still finishes normally — the game is told the advert opened…
